title: PaleoSketch: Accurate Primitive Sketch Recognition and Beautification
core_concept: Recognize primitive stroke types such as lines, arcs, circles, ellipses and curves
boundary_or_caution: Primitive vocabulary precedent; not garment semantics

title: Stroke-based sketched symbol reconstruction and segmentation
core_concept: Stroke meaning depends on shape and contextual placement
boundary_or_caution: Supports stroke/component semantics beyond raw geometry

title: SketchGraphs: A Large-Scale Dataset for Modeling Relational Geometry in Computer-Aided Design
core_concept: Sketches represented as geometric entities plus explicit constraints
boundary_or_caution: Strong precedent for primitives + constraints; CAD is cleaner than garment sketches

title: Vitruvion: A Generative Model of Parametric CAD Sketches
core_concept: Generate primitives and constraints as a structured parametric sketch representation
boundary_or_caution: Closest structural precedent; do not copy CAD assumptions directly

title: Learning to Infer Graphics Programs from Hand-Drawn Images
core_concept: Infer compact programs from hand-drawn images using primitive perception plus program synthesis
boundary_or_caution: Supports executable structure rather than only labels

title: Human-level concept learning through probabilistic program induction
core_concept: Few-shot concept learning through structured generative programs and priors
boundary_or_caution: Strong conceptual fit for small-data WeaveAI

title: Picture: A Probabilistic Programming Language for Scene Perception
core_concept: Infer latent structured explanations by probabilistic generative programs
boundary_or_caution: Supports uncertainty over full structured explanations

title: ShapeAssembly: Learning to Generate Programs for 3D Shape Structure Synthesis
core_concept: Represent shapes using parts, attachments, hierarchy, symmetry and parameters
boundary_or_caution: Useful Lego-like precedent for interpretable assembly structure

title: Multi-Instance Learning by Treating Instances As Non-I.I.D. Samples
core_concept: Treat instances in a bag as inter-correlated components and exploit relations
boundary_or_caution: Key warning: wrong structure can hurt; their graph construction is simple distance-based

title: Neural Relational Inference for Interacting Systems
core_concept: Infer latent interaction graphs and relation types rather than assuming edges
boundary_or_caution: Dynamic-system setting differs; relation-latent idea is the useful precedent

title: A Stochastic Grammar of Images
core_concept: Represent visual concepts compositionally with alternatives and relations
boundary_or_caution: Prior art for probabilistic visual grammar; not garment-specific

title: LADDER: A Language to Describe Drawing, Display, and Editing in Sketch Recognition
core_concept: Describe sketch-domain shapes through lower-level components and constraints
boundary_or_caution: Closest to explicit domain description language

title: SketchREAD: A Multi-Domain Sketch Recognition Engine
core_concept: Use domain structure and context to reinterpret uncertain low-level evidence

title: Image Retrieval using Scene Graphs
core_concept: Represent one scene as entities connected by semantic relations
boundary_or_caution: Useful distinction: scene graph = instance; grammar = language

title: Shape Grammars and the Generative Specification of Painting and Sculpture
core_concept: Use production rules operating directly on shapes
boundary_or_caution: Foundational grammar prior art; not probabilistic and not garment-specific
